query: We're launching a rewards app with an offerwall. How many coins should a dollar be worth, and what share of each offer should go to the user?
Our get-paid-to site pays users 70% and we also give a sign-up bonus, a daily bonus and 10% referral commission. Are we paying out more than we make?
Networks keep reversing conversions three or four weeks after we already paid the user. How long should we hold earnings before withdrawal?
I want to run a double coins weekend and a promo code campaign next month. Check whether our margin survives it.
User balances keep growing and almost nobody cashes out. Is that a problem for us?
Add an offerwall to our site and credit users when the network sends a postback.
Stop people from creating fake accounts to farm our sign-up bonus.
Design the pricing tiers for our SaaS subscription plans.
